_about: Own monster tokens (tools/own_tokens.py, docs/legacy-graphics.md section 6). split: Median's rows leave a token D2R's art also uses for the token `new`, which neither D2R nor Median uses (make_plan refuses a token that has files). complete: a token of Median's own whose rows used to borrow a D2R monster's graphics for want of a COF; Median's art is kept and the missing modes / parts are filled.

tokens.why: Median's Slayer art is on D2R's e9 (Wake of Destruction / Inferno Sentry traps): E9NUHTH has 13 frames and E9S2HTH 14, D2R's animdata records say 2, so D2R's files had to stay and the Slayer drew D2R's trap.
Median ships no DT COF and no right-hand (rh) / S8 DCC for the Horned Gods; the row borrowed Andariel's AN.
Median ships no SC COF for the Couatl Fathers; the rows borrowed the Fallen's FA.
Median ships no S1 / RN COF and only the lit look of the torso for the Risen Dead (JI); the rows borrowed D2R's zombie ZM.

Median ships no art for the Haunts' tokens AM / DZ / SO (player class codes); they borrowed D2R's Corrupt Rogue (CR, 1hs melee in classic, the archer cr_archer1 in HD), whose COFs have no SC: their MonBow (Sk1mode SC / TH) put them in a mode without an animation (bug #74). HN = D2R's CR bow art with the archer's monstats2 row; A2, BL and SC are filled from A1 / NU.
